name: Engineer
description:
A special paint for testers.
This paint is based on principles developed by Nicola Tesla himself. Metal wrenches placed on carbon armor plates generate a magnetic resonance field with properties that haven't been studied to the full extent yet. The coating is installed on special test tanks that are controlled by pilots voluntarily taking part in experiments and risking their lives for the well-being of future generations.
interestingFacts: The author of the paint is Doomby (ex soiko).
